::: {.lede}
I am a wildlife ecologist with extensive carnivore-ungulate field experience and a commitment to collaborative, community-engaged research.
:::

I am broadly interested in how large mammals move, interact, and coexist across working landscapes, integrating spatial ecology, predator-prey dynamics, and human-wildlife interactions to inform conservation and management. I work as an Applied Ecologist with SwampDonkey and am completing my M.Sc. at the University of British Columbia Okanagan on white-tailed deer range expansion in the Columbia Mountains. Before that, I worked on wolf and predator-prey projects in Yellowstone, Isle Royale, the Mexican wolf recovery area, and with the U.S. Geological Survey Wolf and Deer Project in Ely, Minnesota.

## Current work

- **[Wolf pup survival in northeastern Minnesota](projects/snf-wolf-pups/index.qmd).** How long radio-collared wolf pups survived, what killed them, and why, from five decades of telemetry data. Presented at the International Wolf Symposium, 2026.
- **[White-tailed deer range expansion](research.qmd#white-tailed-deer).** What is driving white-tailed deer into the Columbia Mountains of British Columbia.
